newsitem.title: USA: Clinton encouraged by Hebron talks.
newsitem.headline: Clinton encouraged by Hebron talks.

text.p: President Bill Clinton was described as "encouraged" about chances for an agreement between Israel and Palestinian leaders on withdrawing Israeli troops from Hebron, a White House spokeswoman said on Tuesday.

Clinton, relaxing at this resort island for the New Year's holiday, was updated on the situation by U.S. envoy Dennis Ross -- in the Mideast to press both sides to resolve their dispute over the status of the West Bank town.
"Negotiations are continuing and we are encouraged by the prospects," Deputy White House Press Secretary Mary Ellen Glynn said after talking with Clinton.
Ross arrived in the Mideast on Monday and joined the negotiators after private talks with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat.
